prompt: Subject: Gaze from a tide pool. Main subject: A 4:5 vertical photo. In a rocky cove, an adult woman stands at full length slightly to the left of the center, leaning forward while resting both hands on a large rock on the right side. The subject occupies about 70% of the frame, including feet. Appearance: Bright ivory-beige skin with a natural rose flush. Retains texture and fine water droplets without excessive smoothing. Soft rose blush, pink-brown eye shadow, thin natural lashes, soft brown brows, and translucent pink-beige lips. She turns her head toward her right shoulder and looks quietly at the camera with slightly parted lips and a calm, cool expression. Clothing: A simple ivory white two-piece swimsuit. Elegant design with thin shoulder straps and a ribbon tie on the back. She places her hands shoulder-width apart on the rock, fingers naturally spread. Feet are in a shallow tide pool, creating natural reflections. Background: Rocky seashore with shallow water and a blurred blue sea in the distance. Warm morning sunlight from the back-left illuminates hair and shoulders. Shot at 85mm equivalent with shallow depth of field. High-definition realistic photography with natural skin texture and wet hair details.

promptZh: 主体：来自潮汐池的凝视。主要主体：一张 4:5 的竖构图照片。在岩石海湾中，一位成年女性全身站立，位置略偏左，身体前倾，双手撑在右侧的一块大岩石上。主体占据画面约 70% 的比例，包含双脚。外观：明亮的象牙米色皮肤，带有自然的红润感。保留皮肤纹理和细小的水珠，未进行过度磨皮。淡玫瑰色腮红，粉棕色眼影，纤细自然的睫毛，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及半透明的粉米色嘴唇。她转头看向右肩方向，嘴唇微张，神情平静而冷艳，静静地注视着镜头。服装：简洁的 象牙白 分体式泳衣。优雅的设计，带有细肩带和背部系带。她将双手与肩同宽放在岩石上，手指自然张开。双脚位于浅浅的 潮汐池 中，形成自然的倒影。背景：带有浅水的岩石海岸，远处是模糊的蓝色大海。来自左后方的温暖晨光照亮了头发和肩膀。使用 85mm 等效焦距拍摄，具有浅景深效果。高清晰度写实摄影，呈现自然的皮肤质感和湿发细节。
